source_evidence.quote: A naïve Bucher ITC was conducted using data from two well-matched randomized controlled trials: OASIS 4 (once-daily oral semaglutide 25 mg vs. placebo) and STEP 1 (once-weekly s.c. semaglutide 2.4 mg vs. placebo).

findings.claim: The trial-family ledger labels this report PRIMARY, although it is an indirect treatment comparison using two existing trials, not a primary report of a randomized trial. Its exclusion remains appropriate.
